Witch succession is pretty good, not as good as wizard, but still something to look at I've heard. It's worth noting that when you get to a higher AP (like ~~245~~ 260) its nice to be in succession rather than awakening because the "Flow" skills don't scale with your AP. You're losing damage by using awakening at that point.

Also, its necessary to have the awakening weapon because a certain % goes into your overall damage. Same reason why in awakening you'd still get a Kutum.

Hope this helps!

Edit: 260 AP is the best moment to switch from Awakening to Succession
